title: Kawarau River, real Topo50 render
summary: LINZ's own Topo50 rendering near Gibbston: dense 20 m contours, a braided river, state highway and tracks.
attribution: Map: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, via linz/topographic-system (MIT). Data CC BY 4.0.

title: Foot track or closed track?
summary: From the Topo50 legend. A closed, impassable track differs from a foot track only by the length of its gaps.
attribution: Legend: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, via linz/topographic-system (MIT).

title: Hot spring or cold spring?
summary: Same × symbol, different ink. Clear in colour; much harder on a photocopy or under a red light.
attribution: Legend: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, via linz/topographic-system (MIT).

title: Native forest, scrub and scattered scrub
summary: Forest and scrub are pale tints a few steps apart; scattered scrub is a pattern.
attribution: Legend: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, via linz/topographic-system (MIT).

title: Same scene, two styles
summary: A synthetic test scene drawn with the exact colours, widths and fonts of each web style. Not real terrain: use it to compare styles, not to judge the landscape.
attribution: Synthetic terrain. Styles: LINZ topographic-v2 (MIT) and accessible-v0.
